The flight has ended (line items were scheduled to stop at 2027-09-13 04:00 UTC / midnight Toronto on Sep 12→13). Here's the recap.

## Recap — Back-to-School Demo Push (Sep 5–12, 2027)

**Campaign:** `8vlon` "Back-to-School Demo Push — Sep 2027" (ACTIVE but scheduled to end; both line items reached their end_time and stopped serving). Two ad groups, US + Canada geo-targeting only, no age/device restrictions, optimized for link clicks, all 5 approved posts promoted.

**Reported X figures (these are platform-reported, not confirmed demos):**
- Spend: **~$838.60** of the $850 budget
  - Value & offer ad group `uywf9`: $400.94 (118+20 = 138 link clicks, 395,273 impressions)
  - Deadline & urgency ad group `c3tas`: $437.66 (163+24 = 187 link clicks, 441,436 impressions)
- Impressions: **~836,700**
- Link clicks: **325** (~$2.58 per link click)
- The deadline/urgency group outperformed the value group on clicks per dollar, so I shifted budget toward it mid-flight (Sep 8) and raised daily budgets on Sep 11 to use the full allocation.

**Confirmed demo bookings: NOT available from X.** The site has no X pixel, so X cannot see or attribute booked demos. Link clicks above are a proxy only — they include people who opened the calendar, bounced, or never completed a booking. Confirmed booked demos must come from your scheduling system's appointment records; I have no access to it, so I can't report that number. Please pull confirmed appointments (booked between Sep 5–12, or from this campaign's traffic) from the scheduling system to measure the actual objective.

**Notes / caveats:**
- All 5 approved posts were used; no new posts were written. No post-level pausing tool exists, so weaker creatives (2227089127635860770 and 2226907933702005266 had the lowest CTRs early) kept serving but received proportionally less spend as the algorithm optimized; the deadline group as a whole got the budget shift.
- Line items ended automatically at midnight Toronto time at the end of Sep 12; the campaign itself remains in ACTIVE status with no serving line items. Pause the campaign if you want it fully closed out.
- Discrepancy to be aware of: X-reported "link clicks" (325) will not equal confirmed demo bookings — treat any per-click ROI math accordingly until scheduling records are reconciled.
